<?php
$slot = "5";
$old_alias =& $slot;
$other = 20;
$object = new class(first: $slot, ignored: ($slot =& $other), second: $slot) {
    public function __construct($ignored, int &...$values) {
        foreach ($values as $key => $value) {
            echo $key, ":", $value, "|";
            $values[$key] = $value + 1;
        }
        echo "fixed|", $ignored, "|";
    }
};
echo $slot, "|", $old_alias, "|", $other, "|";
echo $old_alias === 6 ? "old-int|" : "wrong|";

<?php
function head154Review() { echo "head|"; return 1; }
function good154Review() { echo "good|"; return 2; }
function bad154Review() { echo "bad|"; return "bad"; }
function late154Review() { echo "late|"; return 4; }
try {
    $typed = new class(head154Review(), good154Review(), bad154Review(), late154Review()) {
        public function __construct($head, int ...$tail) { echo "typed-body|"; }
    };
} catch (TypeError $error) {
    echo $error->getMessage(), "|";
}
echo "after-type|";
try {
    $reference = new class(1, late154Review()) {
        public function __construct(&...$refs) { echo "reference-body|"; }
    };
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo $error instanceof TypeError ? "type|" : "send|";
    echo $error->getMessage(), "|";
}
echo "after|";

<?php
$tail154 = "2";
echo "before|";
$object154 = new class(1, $tail154, 3, 4) {
    public $sum;
    public $typed;
    public function __construct(int $head, int ...$rest) {
        $this->typed = $rest[0] === 2;
        $this->sum = $head + $rest[0] + $rest[1] + $rest[2];
    }
};
echo $object154->typed, "|", $object154->sum, "|", $tail154;
echo $tail154 === "2" ? "|caller-string|" : "|changed|";
echo "after";

<?php
$first154 = "2";
$last154 = "3";
$alias154 =& $first154;
echo "before|";
$object154 = new class(1, $first154, later: $last154) {
    public $sum;
    public function __construct(int $head, int &...$rest) {
        echo $rest[0] === 2 ? "first-int|" : "bad-first|";
        echo $rest["later"] === 3 ? "last-int|" : "bad-last|";
        $rest[0] += 10;
        $rest["later"] += 20;
        $this->sum = $head + $rest[0] + $rest["later"];
    }
};
echo $object154->sum, "|", $first154, "|", $alias154, "|", $last154, "|after";

<?php
$source154 = 'namespace Ref154Author;
function make154() {
    return new class(last: 5) {
        public $sum;
        public function __construct(int $head = 7, int ...$rest) {
            $this->sum = $head + $rest["last"];
        }
    };
}';
eval($source154);
$first154 = Ref154Author\make154();
$second154 = Ref154Author\make154();
$empty154 = new class {
    public $size;
    public function __construct(...$rest) {
        $this->size = count($rest);
    }
};
echo $first154->sum, "|", $second154->sum, "|", $empty154->size, "|after";

<?php
function extra154Hole() { echo "extra|"; return 9; }
echo "before|";
try {
    $object154 = new class(second: 2, last: extra154Hole()) {
        public function __construct(int $first, int $second, int ...$tail) {
            echo "body|";
        }
    };
} catch (ArgumentCountError $error154) {
    echo $error154->getMessage(), "|";
}
echo "after";
